note: Compact digest of the ATM-CACHE-001 full study. Every number here is derived mechanically from the published per-task results, which stay in the external evidence directory; this file exists so the repository carries the conclusions without duplicating 280 MB of raw summaries.

sensitivity.description: largest observed spans across five archived weather regimes, both models
sensitivity.interpretation: density changes by more than two orders of magnitude over 100 km of altitude, which forces kilometre-scale cells or finer for any interpolating cache

provider_cost_components_ns.note: uninstrumented build, 2000 operations per repeat, each on its own timer
provider_cost_components_ns.interpretation: the native model call is only 30-37 percent of the provider call; the remaining 63-70 percent is acquisition that a density cache still pays, bounding any achievable speedup before lookup cost

reconstruction_accuracy.judged_on: maximum absolute relative error over four holdout packets and every weather epoch

approximation_active_proof.description: cell-interior pairs at fractions 0.23 and 0.76 of each cell, scored against fresh references never injected into the cache

coupled_propagation.scope: worst over CASE-A/B/C, 6 h and 24 h, all perturbation levels, both models
coupled_propagation.D_adaptive_refinement: never propagated; it never cleared accuracy screening

end_to_end_speedup.rule: median ratio of interleaved repeats of the same workload against an authoritative configuration measured on the same route, thread count and ensemble in this same run
interpretation: every configuration is slower than not caching on real trajectory work, between 0.53x and 1.12x
exact memoisation wins only where the caller repeats an identical state (1.59-2.09x); an adaptive integrator does not repeat states
fine 4-D interpolation collapses to 0.065-0.071x on JB2008, a 14x slowdown, because a cold query builds up to 2^4 native nodes

native_domain_coverage.measured_by: docs/atmosphere/cache-study/coverage.py at the study's own tolerances
native_domain_coverage.note: an earlier apparent NRLMSISE-00 altitude excursion came from the study's own auxiliary packet generator, not from any trajectory; the defect is fixed and the gate retained

input_compatibility.comparison: five historical fixture epochs by model, UTC epoch, latitude, longitude and altitude, binary64 bit comparison
input_compatibility.claim_limit: equivalence over the tested fixture domain only; not byte equivalence between SOLFSMY releases and not universal scientific equivalence

recommendation.decision: do not implement a production atmospheric density cache, for either model
basis: no approximate configuration met the 0.1 percent or 0.01 percent density budget
every configuration meeting the 1 percent screening threshold was slower than the current provider on trajectory work
the accurate configurations are the expensive ones: interpolation must build native nodes per query
the only accurate-and-fast option, exact memoisation, only pays when states repeat, which the production integrator does not do

limitations: evidence class is scientific-experimental-pinned, not direct-v2: the historical SOLFSMY pin is unavailable; the recovered Earth PCK is byte-identical to its historical pin and the five-epoch comparison shows zero differing bits
coupled propagation and performance use a single epoch; sensitivity uses five archived regimes
threaded ensembles are measured at one worker count per ensemble size
these results apply to a density-only seam; callers needing temperature or constituents cannot use any such cache

harness_defects_found_and_fixed.defect: provider cost components divided a single timed operation by the batch count
--study-points multiplied the locality packet epoch spread and along-track offset
harness_defects_found_and_fixed.effect: the sample count decided whether a run succeeded; the auxiliary probe left the models' documented domain at 16384 points
